raw_segments.text: Yet, when the young lady came from boarding school on a visit, the whole town revived.
Our most distinguished ladies, two excellencies and a colonel's wife, and all the rest following
their lead, at once took her up and gave entertainments in her honor.
She was the belle of the balls and picnics, and they got up Tableau's Vivints in aid
of distressed governesses.
I took no notice.
I went on as wildly as before, and one of my exploits at the time set all the town talking.
I saw her eyes taking my measure one evening at the Battery Commanders, but I didn't
go up to her, as though I disdained her acquaintance.
I did go up and speak to her at an evening party not long after.
She scarcely looked at me and compressed her lips scornfully.
Wait a bit!
I'll have my revenge! thought I, I behaved like an awful fool on many occasions at that
time, and I was conscious of it myself.
What made it worse was that I felt that Katinka was not an innocent boarding school miss,
but a person of character, proud and really high-principled.
Above all, she had education and intellect, and I had neither.
You think I meant to make her an offer?
No, I simply wanted to revenge myself because I was such a hero and she didn't seem to
feel it.
